display_long_description:
Step into situations that once felt out of reach — and experience them differently.

ClaustrOFF: Simulations is an immersive virtual reality experience designed to help you gradually adapt to confined environments through realistic and controlled scenarios. Instead of avoiding uncomfortable situations, you can now explore them in a safe space where you stay in control.

The app recreates everyday environments that may feel challenging:

- MRI examination
- Elevator rides
- Airplane cabin

Each simulation is designed to be approachable and repeatable, allowing you to progress at your own pace. Start with lighter scenarios and gradually move toward more intensive experiences as your confidence grows.

What makes it unique:

- High-quality, realistic VR environments
- Gradual progression system
- Freedom to explore at your own pace
- Designed with input from psychology and digital health experts
- Suitable for independent use or guided sessions

ClaustrOFF: Simulations focuses on helping you build familiarity and a calmer response through repeated exposure in a controlled setting. Whether you're preparing for a real-life situation or simply want to feel more comfortable in confined spaces, this experience gives you a practical and accessible way to train.

Important:
This experience is intended for wellbeing and training purposes only and does not replace professional care.
